clos.loDetails: Students understand, remember and familiarize themselves with the basics of Housekeeping Department, skills, procedures and operations; tools and means to do the job; connect to this subject knowledge with other subjects of hospitality management.
Students are  able to demonstrate basic room cleaning procedures ; Experienced in practical service and grasp the behavior of professional housekeeping attendant.

Students can analyze and identify the types of services and procedures appropriate for each type of accommodation; Flexible handling of different types of room cleaning and can be adjusted flexibly for each specific situation.
Students are trained to perform professional ethics; have the spirit and professional attitude; Forming the love of work and the spirit of serving the society as professional service staff.
